node.label: Reduced C27 3beta-HSD activity in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: Concentration or activity of 3beta-hydroxy-delta5-C27-steroid oxidoreductase (C27 3beta-HSD) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.

evidence.snippet: Bile acid synthesis defect, congenital, 1: Reduced C27 3beta-HSD activity in cultured fibroblasts (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
